name: StartLux-Decision-v1.1-4B-Instant
note: StartLux Labs' StartLux-Decision-v1.1-4B-Instant (Hugging Face startlux-models/StartLux-Decision-v1.1-4B-Instant @ 416088f77cfce09633906a3675c7cd2e5dabcf10, CC BY-NC 4.0, run for this non-commercial benchmark as the 0.8B and 2B; a Qwen3.5 (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration) 4B with bidirectional prompt attention, per-type temperatures from decision_config.json, choice 1.1103) on our GPU through its package's own server, as the card serves it: startlux-decide 1.1.0 (github.com/StartLuxLabs/StartLux-Decision @ a99977d, clean) serve --launch-vllm with the package's vLLM plugin, vLLM 0.31.0 (torch 2.13.0+cu130), BF16 as released, context 131,072. Instant: one read-out per pass, no thinking; 26 letters per pass incl. the hidden 'None of the above' (serve's default none_check), longer lists knocked out by the server in groups of <=25 (3 kept, final pass); 255 options per request (the league's rule). Never truncates: vLLM refuses over 131,072 tokens (422). League 1's longest stored request (251 options) is about 27k tokens as one prompt (counted with the 0.8B's Qwen3.5 tokenizer), far under 131,072.
device: NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark spark2, spark-d9ee), the whole GPU, handed over by logic one server at a time: startlux-decide serve --model <snapshot> --launch-vllm --gpus 0 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 19410
